IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
CIVIL APPEAL NOS.298-299 OF 2010
(Arising out of S.L.P. (C) Nos.20821-20822 of 2009)
Commissioner of Central Excise              ...Appellant(s)
Versus
M/s. Polyplastic
                   ...Respondent(s)
O  R  D  E  R
Leave granted.
None appears for the respondent, though served.
The issue involved in these appeals stand covered 
by the following two decisions of this Court reported in 
the cases of Commissioner of Central Excise, Pune vs. SKF 
India  Limited,  reported  in  [2009]   239   E.L.T.385  and 
Commissioner of Central Excise vs. M/s. International Auto 
Limited [Civil Appeal No.225 of 2010 @ S.L.P. (C) No.17339 
of 2009] delivered on 8th January, 2010.
Accordingly,  the  civil appeals  stand disposed  of 
with no order as to costs.
......................J.
           [S.H. KAPADIA]
......................J.
           [SWATANTER KUMAR]
New Delhi,
January 15, 2010.
